title: Respirited Coven
description: Bring whimsy and beauty to witches!
body:
![pack title - respirited coven](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34d8c820a4fc4add252475045d030be10fdbefd4.png) ![the coven!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f7aa3815b6f34ee59309b9bf268dea16471ea2e.png) > #### 7 unique witches that can spawn randomly and a black cat with a hat! --- ![effect sprites](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f13169132aaab32f669ea59c8deba03e57538a77.png) ![pack items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40a73d744ebb4fe84d08aae8153eeb6108f459e7.png) > #### Effect sprites and items > ###### Normal potion, dragon breath, bottle o' enchanting, witch spawn egg, and enchanted book, respectively --- ![enchanting table block and gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6e196d4aa2fecee059120a012b868f4764f2dc9.png) > #### Enchanting table and GUI --- #### This pack requires [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home) or the [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) mods to work. #### It also supports [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) configurations, almost every feature can be disabled through it. If you don't want to use it, feel free to change the texture files, but you must never distribute it elsewhere. --- ##### This pack **_should_** work on Minecraft versions other than the ones available for download, since there's no difference between the files except for the pack.mcmeta. It surely works between 1.20 and 26.1.2, but i haven't tested it for older versions, but probably works the same.
Future Plans - Respirit every item related to potion-making (blaze rod, the brewing stand, etc)
- Summon unique textures for every potion and enchantments
- Respirit every effect icon
